name: mcore-bump-base-image
author: NVIDIA
description: Bump the NVIDIA PyTorch base image (`nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:YY.MM-py3`) used by Megatron-LM CI. Covers the two pin sites (GitHub CI in `docker/.ngc_version.dev` and GitLab CI in `.gitlab/stages/01.build.yml`), the post-bump CI loop (re-run functional tests, refresh golden values, mark broken tests), and the gotchas that bit PRs
